Data:Talk.visitor.intro.stanislav.wound..label: On the Open Reverend
Data:Talk.visitor.intro.stanislav.wound..startdescription: 'The poor soul used to be my friend. I'm not sure what he is now.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=heart> as their <sprite name=heart> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.intro.yvette.box.json.label: On the Messenger's Casket
Data:Talk.visitor.intro.yvette.box.json.startdescription: 'St Mihail's Coffin is all the gossip… but I'm here about a different saint.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=moon>  as their <sprite name=moon> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.intro.yvette.curse.jso.label: On the Grunewald Provision
Data:Talk.visitor.intro.yvette.curse.jso.startdescription: 'These Grunewald curios… I've acquired one of my own. A device. The Bureau had assured me it was safe… I had commissioned repairs… but now, as you can imagine, I'm having doubts.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=winter> as their <sprite name=winter> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.intro.yvette.intrusion.label: On the Endless Guest
Data:Talk.visitor.intro.yvette.intrusion.startdescription: 'I'm here about Hobson. The Bureau's invited me to interview him - assess him. I don't think I want to, but I don't think I can pass up the opportunity…' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=winter> as their <sprite name=winter> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.intro.yvette.mob.json.label: On the Forgivable Debt
Data:Talk.visitor.intro.yvette.mob.json.startdescription: 'I wouldn't be here if I hadn't heard about the Reckoner war… but it's not the Reckoner war that interests me. It's the trade in years.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=moon> as their <sprite name=moon> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.intro.yvette.mystical..label: On the Particular Mystique
Data:Talk.visitor.intro.yvette.mystical..startdescription: 'Funniest thing. I keep getting speaking invitations from this odd little outfit: 'Church of the Ivory Dawn'. And, well, you'll laugh, Librarian…' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=winter> as their <sprite name=winter> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.intro.yvette.rising.js.label: On the Rising While
Data:Talk.visitor.intro.yvette.rising.js.startdescription: 'I'm here about a dream. I know; physician, interpret thyself, all that. Indulge me.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=moon> as their <sprite name=moon> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.intro.yvette.rite.rene.label: On the Friar's Tapestry
Data:Talk.visitor.intro.yvette.rite.rene.startdescription: 'A patient of mine is troubled by a dream of a lake. He swims out, he dives, he is reborn beneath the moon… we identified it just last month as Gladwyn Lake. He has never been there. He wants to go. And now, just now, I hear about this business of the Tapestry, and the rite.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=moon> as their <sprite name=moon> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.intro.yvette.wound.jso.label: On the Open Reverend
Data:Talk.visitor.intro.yvette.wound.jso.startdescription: ''O.R.' - I knew he was troubled. He was a patient of mine, before what happened to him. Whatever exactly that is!'

Data:Talk.visitor.intro.zachary.box.json.label: On the Messenger's Casket
Data:Talk.visitor.intro.zachary.box.json.startdescription: 'It was open once before. When they locked him away…' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=knock> as their <sprite name=knock> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.intro.zachary.curse.js.label: On the Grunewald Provision
Data:Talk.visitor.intro.zachary.curse.js.startdescription: 'I'm sorry for what happened. With the Circus.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=winter> as their <sprite name=winter> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.intro.zachary.heist.js.label: On the Oriflamme Heist
Data:Talk.visitor.intro.zachary.heist.js.startdescription: 'I don't like what they say happened. I don't like it at all.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=knock> as their <sprite name=knock> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.intro.zachary.intrusio.label: On the Endless Guest
Data:Talk.visitor.intro.zachary.intrusio.startdescription: 'Hobson. He was my friend. (Now, he might be my friends.) I have to know what to do.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=knock> or Mystery: <sprite name=winter> as their matching Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.intro.zachary.mystical.label: On the Particular Mystique
Data:Talk.visitor.intro.zachary.mystical.startdescription: 'Everyone's always looking.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=winter> as their <sprite name=winter> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.intro.zachary.wound.js.label: On the Open Reverend
Data:Talk.visitor.intro.zachary.wound.js.startdescription: 'If one has chosen to be opened, why would one wish to be closed?' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=winter> as their <sprite name=winter> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.julian.json.label: A Conversation with Julian Coseley
Data:Talk.visitor.julian.json.startdescription: '...if Solomon is gone...if Solomon remains...' [If there's an Incident card active, you can discuss it - or just leave the slot empty and offer a Consultation.]

Data:Talk.visitor.morgen.json.label: A Conversation with Mlle Matutine
Data:Talk.visitor.morgen.json.startdescription: 'Perhaps I should call myself 'Saphir', hein?' [If there's an Incident card active, you can discuss it - or just leave the slot empty and offer a Consultation.]

Data:Talk.visitor.numa.intro.auntmopsy.n.label: On the Counterfeit Memory
Data:Talk.visitor.numa.intro.auntmopsy.n.startdescription: 'I don't need what I'm here for… but I do need you to help me find it.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=moon> as their <sprite name=moon> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.numa.intro.auntmopsy.n.label: On the Midnight Twin
Data:Talk.visitor.numa.intro.auntmopsy.n.startdescription: 'When I know what we're looking for, I'll know what I've seen. Could you help with that, dear?' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=moon> as their <sprite name=moon> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.numa.intro.auntmopsy.n.label: On Knot and Tangle
Data:Talk.visitor.numa.intro.auntmopsy.n.startdescription: 'If I were only here to cause mischief, dear, and I told you as much, wouldn't that also mean I was here to bring you a message?' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=nectar> as their <sprite name=nectar> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.numa.intro.franklin.nu.label: On the Sanctuary Draught
Data:Talk.visitor.numa.intro.franklin.nu.startdescription: '…the joy I shared with Lady Eva. The delights of our…' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=grail> as their <sprite name=grail> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.numa.intro.franklin.nu.label: On the Feasting Few
Data:Talk.visitor.numa.intro.franklin.nu.startdescription: '…conspiracy of roses. There are other appetites than love…' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=grail> as their <sprite name=grail> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.numa.intro.franklin.nu.label: On Knot and Tangle
Data:Talk.visitor.numa.intro.franklin.nu.startdescription: '…must not be stilled. No dance without a partner, no drum without a skin…' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=grail> as their <sprite name=grail> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.numa.intro.julian.numa.label: On the Counterfeit Memory
Data:Talk.visitor.numa.intro.julian.numa.startdescription: '…the King, or the Bell, or the City. Without History, none of them…' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=moon> as their <sprite name=moon> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.numa.intro.julian.numa.label: On the Midnight Twin
Data:Talk.visitor.numa.intro.julian.numa.startdescription: '…facile chatter about balance and harmony. No time for that at all. But as the other magus said, when a thing is kept too long from its opposite…' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=moon> as their <sprite name=moon> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.numa.intro.rowena.numa.label: On the Sanctuary Draught
Data:Talk.visitor.numa.intro.rowena.numa.startdescription: 'If I were here, it would be only because I could not stay away.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=grail> as their <sprite name=grail> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.numa.intro.rowena.numa.label: On the Feasting Few
Data:Talk.visitor.numa.intro.rowena.numa.startdescription: 'If I were here… perhaps it is the Twins that would have brought me. It is the Twins who unite what must not be apart. And so I share their patronage with my sisters-in-blood. As Bancroft used to say, there are other appetites than love.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=grail> as their <sprite name=grail> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.numa.intro.rowena.numa.label: On the Softer Frost
Data:Talk.visitor.numa.intro.rowena.numa.startdescription: 'Hush House; Brancrug; the grey rock in the sea. There will be a last time that I come here. But not yet.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=winter> as their <sprite name=winter> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.numa.intro.rowena.numa.label: On Knot and Tangle
Data:Talk.visitor.numa.intro.rowena.numa.startdescription: 'Without the Red Grail, I would never have come here. Without the Red Grail, I would have died happy. But I'd have died.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=grail> as their <sprite name=grail> Interest.]
